population_definition: all kernels in shard FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B28-1, enumerated below by kernel id and spec digest
independence_sentence: Each item listed was reviewed and attested independently; the single signature is a mechanical convenience over the enumerated digests, not a bulk review.
per_item_basis_of_review: Every row ran the same two mechanical checks unconditionally: (1) the fixture-oracle gate — compute() output diffed against the kernel's own existing golden fixtures before any property was trusted, and (2) run-proptests.mjs green (process exit 0). ULP-boundary forcing was mandatory and present for the 4 float-sensitive rows named in the WU (art-243, art-244, art-298, art-299). The other 5 rows (art-245, art-246, art-290, art-295, art-296) are the row's stated float:no exceptions and instead carry forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases (exact string-length thresholds, exact ISO-date-string thresholds, mod-97 check-digit edges, weighted-score boundary sums, enum tier/cutoff combinations) in place of ULP forcing. One property definition was corrected during authoring after direct measurement against the kernel found the initial assumption false: art-295's regime-country resolution property initially checked CONFIRMED_DATE_REGIMES membership directly for precedence, but the kernel resolves regime_country by MANDATE_TABLE membership first (which includes the two DRAFT-PIN countries AE/MY) — the property was corrected to mirror that exact precedence before checking for a date-confirmed regime, else it produced false property violations against a correct kernel. No row beyond these mechanical checks received a separate in-depth human review in this pass — that is exactly the gap human_sign_off.status=PENDING names.
